description: This file defines the 'Language' model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing language data including retrieval by ID or code, and fetching all languages with caching.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Model class providing methods to interact with language data stored in the database, including fetching language details by ID or code and retrieving all available languages.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language record based on its primary key ID, constructs the image URL accordingly, and caches the result.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language record based on its code, constructs the image URL accordingly, and caches the result.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Fetches all active language records, caches the results, and constructs image URLs for each language.
